function_summary: Compact geared stepper motor for controlled mechanical positioning.
classification_reason: Motor or actuator component; requires structural links and mounts to become an arm or leg.
assembly_notes: One motor; driver, controller, mounting and link structure are additional.
evidence_note: Product identifies 24BYJ48 stepper and cites louvers, small fans and curtains as applications.

function_summary: Angular-position servo supplied with a Grove connector.
classification_reason: Motor or actuator component; requires structural links and mounts to become an arm or leg.
assembly_notes: Servo with Grove connection; robot links and controller are not a completed limb in this product.
evidence_note: Description identifies rotary position control and the Grove-standard three-wire servo connector.

function_summary: Serial-bus smart servo with metal gearbox and magnetic angle sensing.
classification_reason: Motor or actuator component; requires structural links and mounts to become an arm or leg.
assembly_notes: One ST3215-C047 servo; complete arm structure, power and adapter/control system are separate.
evidence_note: Description identifies serial bus, angle encoder and use in SO-ARM101.

function_summary: Grove I2C driver board for DC or stepper motors.
classification_reason: Control electronics support moving parts but are not a physical limb.
assembly_notes: Motor-driver module; motors, power and host controller separate.
evidence_note: Product identifies the TB6612FNG motor-driver board and DC/stepper use.

function_summary: Compact ESP32-S3 development board with wireless connectivity.
classification_reason: Programmable control and communications are support functions, regardless of where the board is mounted.
assembly_notes: XIAO ESP32-S3 board SKU; expansion boards, sensing modules and actuators separate.
evidence_note: Product description names the ESP32-S3 processor and Wi-Fi/BLE connectivity.

function_summary: Raspberry Pi 5 single-board computer with 8 GB memory.
classification_reason: Computation belongs to internal support rather than a structural head or torso.
assembly_notes: Computer board variant; enclosure, camera, power and storage are separate selections.
evidence_note: Product identifies the 8 GB Pi 5 board; page distinguishes board from starter-kit choices.

function_summary: Ultrasonic module measures distance to nearby objects.
classification_reason: Perception or orientation component; not a physical head assembly.
assembly_notes: Sensor module; controller, wiring integration and mounting required.
evidence_note: Description identifies ultrasonic ranging and robot obstacle avoidance.

function_summary: IMU combines angular-motion, acceleration and magnetic-field sensing.
classification_reason: Perception or orientation component; not a physical head assembly.
assembly_notes: Grove sensor module; host processor and mounting required.
evidence_note: Official wiki explains gyro, accelerometer and compass functions after storefront fetch failed.

function_summary: VL53L0X time-of-flight module provides optical distance measurements.
classification_reason: Perception or orientation component; not a physical head assembly.
assembly_notes: Sensor board; host controller and physical mount separate.
evidence_note: Product description identifies VL53L0X-based ToF ranging.

function_summary: Six-wheel mobile chassis with six geared DC motors and an aluminum body.
classification_reason: Ground locomotion makes the platform a legs/base selection rather than a torso-only frame.
assembly_notes: Chassis and drivetrain kit; controller and motor drivers shown as separate add-ons, not a complete autonomous robot.
evidence_note: Description lists six DC motors, gearboxes and mounting holes for Arduino/Raspberry Pi.

function_summary: Servo motor, adapter-board and cable kit for constructing an SO-ARM101 arm.
classification_reason: Motor or actuator component; requires structural links and mounts to become an arm or leg.
assembly_notes: Motor kit excludes 3D-printed structural parts and camera; the downloaded full-arm CAD includes structure that this SKU does not supply.
evidence_note: Official product description and explicit exclusion note distinguish motor kit from assembled/unassembled arm bundles.

function_summary: LiPo charge-and-boost board supplies regulated outputs from a battery.

assembly_notes: Charger/booster board; LiPo cell and protected battery arrangement must be supplied separately.
evidence_note: Official wiki describes charging, boosting and external battery connection after storefront fetch failed.
